correctness.rationale: The exact interpolation reconstruction over Q(sqrt(5)) has rank 27 in the 28-dimensional sextic space after imposing the fifteen point conditions and order-five jet conditions at P=[3:5:1], hence a unique witness up to scale. Its local equation has only degree-five and degree-six pieces A5 and B6. Exact polynomial gcds give gcd(A5,B6)=1 and gcd(A5,dA5)=1, so the tangent quintic is squarefree and the witness cannot factor. Thus the marked point is an ordinary quintuple point and the curve is irreducible. An ordinary quintuple point contributes delta ten, equal to the arithmetic genus of a plane sextic, so the normalization has genus zero and there can be no other singularities. Irreducibility and tangent discriminant nonvanishing are open on the one-dimensional-kernel locus, giving the generic statement.
